jobs.occupation: AP / Junior Accountant - Sint Pieters Leeuw - English   Fr / Du
jobs.description:
Our client is a stable player based in the south of Brussels. You will join a strong and supportive team, where your onboarding will be coordinated by several colleagues to ensure a smooth integration into the company.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP / Junior Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Process supplier invoices and ensure that accounting data is entered accurately.
• Processing bank transactions.
• Managing supplier master data
• Check invoice details against available documentation to maintain reliable records.
• Help maintain up-to-date supplier account information for daily finance activities.
• Follow up on missing invoice details and resolve basic processing queries.
• Reconcile invoice information with accounting records to identify differences.
• Support the preparation of regular finance reports with accurate data.
• Contribute to efficient administrative processes within the Accounting & Finance department.

• Bachelor or Master in Accounting (or equivalent through experience).
• Ability to process invoices with care and accuracy.
• You have an excellent command of English and are fluent in either French or Dutch, with a good working knowledge of the other language.
• Comfort working with routine accounting and administrative tasks.
• Ability to prepare clear and accurate financial information.
• A hands-on mindset with a genuine desire to learn and grow.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

We are looking for a Tech Operator, working in Ypres. You will be working in the early/late shift. The main focus will be:
 
 
 
• Advanced OP error solving

As Receptionist & Facility Officer, you will be the first point of contact for members and visitors and will support the smooth day-to-day operation of the office.
 

You will manage reception and visitor processes, oversee office readiness, coordinate meeting rooms and on-site event logistics, and support essential services such as catering, stationery, mailroom and archives.
 

You will also coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance of key facility systems and assist with practical facility projects, including storage and furniture inventory. Through this varied role, you will help provide a professional, safe and positive working environment for employees, members and visitors. You will work at the  Secretariat in Brussels, reporting directly to the Facility Manager.
 

Your responsibilities 
 

 Your responsibilities will vary based on priorities and projects and may include, but are not limited to: 

 
• bull;    Act as the main point of contact for  members and visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming reception experience. 
 
• bull;    Carry out daily office checks and take appropriate action to ensure that workspaces are clean, functional and ready for daily operations. 
 
• bull;    Support catering coordination, stationery, the mailroom and archives to ensure the availability of essential office resources. 
 
• bull;    Manage meeting room bookings, room set-up and associated services, and coordinate logistical support for on-site events. 
 
• bull;    Coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance for electrical systems, HVAC, access control, alarms, audiovisual systems and other key equipment. 
 
• bull;    Assist with facility projects, including storage management and maintenance of the furniture inventory, to support the effective use of space and resources. 
  

We are looking for a motivated candidate with the following skills and abilities:
 
 
 
• High school qualification or an equivalent level gained through professional experience. 
 
• 1-3 years of relevant experience in reception, office services or facilities support. 
 
• Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools, including Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook and SharePoint. 
 
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, with a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
 
• A collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to build positive working relationships and respond effectively to different audiences. 
 
• A strong sense of accountability, reliability and integrity, with the ability to follow procedures and meet commitments. 
 
• Good organisational and problem-solving skills, including the ability to plan, prioritise and deliver work on time. 
 
• Ability to work independently and in a team setting while managing competing priorities. 
 
• Willingness and availability to work from the office five days a week (Monday to Friday). 
 
• Positive mindset aligned with the values of  Team, Trust, Integrity, Excellence and Future-thinking.

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

jobs.occupation: Fine Food Packaging & Quality Control Assistant
jobs.description:
Are you detail-oriented and do you enjoy precise, hands-on work? Our client in Vlezenbeek is looking for a Fine Food Packaging & Quality Control Assistant to support the packaging of high-quality herbs and food products.

Gross salary: €15.53/hour

Your responsibilities:

 
• Carefully packaging delicate herbs and food products.
 
• Applying and checking labels with great accuracy.
 
• Performing visual quality inspections.
 
• Handling products with care to preserve their quality and appearance.
 
• Entering basic production data into the computer system.
 
• Following quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
 
• Keeping the workstation clean and organized.
 
• This position requires excellent attention to detail, patience and precision. Quality is always more important than speed.

 
• You communicate well in English.
 
• A basic knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset.
 
• You are comfortable using a computer.
 
• You have a strong eye for detail and quality.
 
• You enjoy precise and repetitive manual tasks.
 
• You are patient, accurate and able to stay focused throughout the day.
 
• Experience in packaging, quality control, assembly work, food production, cosmetics or pharmaceutical manufacturing is an advantage.
 
• You follow procedures carefully and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
 
• You are reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

Important: This role is best suited for candidates who enjoy fine, detail-focused work rather than heavy physical production or logistics tasks. We are looking for someone who values accuracy, quality and careful handling of products.

Your role as a Warehouse Picker

As a warehouse picker, you are responsible for:

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar

You develop our presence in Flanders among professional advisors: accounting firms (10+ people), notaries, family offices and independent wealth advisors. Your job is to understand how these firms work with their private clients, identify where wealth planning creates value for them, and show how we help them deliver it.

This is consultative selling. Sales cycles typically run from 5 to 9 months, and up to 18 months with larger organisations. Your credibility with partners and senior advisors rests first on your understanding of their profession and of private wealth matters. Sales technique comes second.

We're a technology provider. Your role is to understand advisors' needs and the wealth issues they handle, not to advise their end clients.
What you will do
Prospecting and discovery

• Work from an existing, qualified target list of firms and decision-makers in Flanders
• Lead in-depth discovery conversations with partners to understand their practice, their clients' wealth issues and their growth ambition.
• Translate these needs into concrete use cases for our company.
Advising and convincing

• Discuss succession, gifting and wealth structuring topics with advisors on an equal footing, and connect them to what the platform does
• Run tailored demos built around realistic client situations
• Answer business and technical questions, and bring in product or domain experts when needed
• Follow opportunities over long cycles, from first conversation to signature
Pipeline and network

• Manage your opportunities and forecasts in HubSpot
• Develop your network through professional associations, events, webinars and partnerships
Collaboration

• Work closely with our VP Sales and our Revenue Team Lead
• Share field insights with Marketing and Product: client needs, objections, gaps What we are looking for
Essential

• In-depth knowledge of Belgian private wealth: succession and gift planning (including Flemish rules), matrimonial regimes, life insurance, holding and company structures, real estate, and the related tax aspects
• Professional experience in a wealth-related environment: private banking, wealth planning or management, insurance brokerage, estate planning, tax advice, accounting or notarial practice
• The ability to hold credible, substantive conversations with partners and senior advisor.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (our working language)
A strong plus

• Familiarity with how accounting firms, notaries or independent advisors work: business models, client relationships, regulatory constraints, current challenges
• An existing network among Flemish advisors
• French
Personal qualities

• Curiosity and rigour: you like to understand before you propose
• Patience and consistency over long cycles, and relationships built to last
• Sound commercial instinct: you sense when to move forward, when to wait, and how to turn a good conversation into an opportunity
• Autonomy and an entrepreneurial mindset: you shape the role as the market develops
Formal sales experience is not a prerequisite. If you come from accounting, tax or wealth advisory and want to move into business development, we would like to hear from you.
 What we offer
• Real ownership in a market where our company already has references, active leads and a qualified target list
• Close support from experienced colleagues in sales and wealth planning
• Room to grow as our company expands into new markets
• Hybrid work, with regular field presence in Flanders
• Employee or freelance status, a package based on seniority, and commission on sales

Drive business growth by prospecting new B2B clients, developing long-term relationships and promoting innovative digital solutions across the Brussels region. Manage the full sales cycle, from identifying opportunities to closing deals, while working closely with internal teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

Client Details

Our client is a leading provider of digital solutions that help businesses optimise their operations, improve efficiency and accelerate their growth.

To support its continued expansion in Belgium, the company is looking for a Field Sales Representative to strengthen its commercial presence in the Brussels region.

Description

As a Field Sales Representative, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and expanding the customer portfolio within your assigned territory.

 

Key responsibilities include:

 

• Identifying and approaching new B2B prospects across Brussels and surrounding areas
• Managing face-to-face client meetings and building long-term relationships
• Understanding customer challenges and presenting tailored digital solutions
• Managing the sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature
• Working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience
 

A successful Field Sales Representative should have:

 

• 1 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales, field sales or account management
• A strong commercial mindset and hunter mentality
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills
• Fluency in French or Dutch, with a good command of English
• The ability to work independently and take ownership of a territory
• A valid driving licence (B)

As Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of professional customers and ensuring a seamless customer experience throughout the entire order and service lifecycle.

Client Details

Our client is an international organization operating in a highly technical environment. The company collaborates with customers across multiple sectors and is known for delivering customized solutions and long-term service partnerships.

To support the growth of its Belgian activities, the organization is looking for an experienced Customer Service Specialist to join its customer operations team.

Description

As Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of professional customers and ensuring a seamless customer experience throughout the entire order and service lifecycle.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities include:

• Acting as the primary point of contact for customers regarding orders, deliveries, contract-related matters and service requests.
• Managing a high volume of customer interactions by phone and email on a daily basis.
• Ensuring timely follow-up on customer requests and coordinating with internal departments to provide accurate information and solutions.
• Building strong relationships with customers by delivering a professional, responsive and service-oriented experience.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience within Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or a similar customer-facing administrative role.
• Previous experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment is a strong asset.
• Fluent in Dutch and French with a professional command of English.
• Comfortable communicating with customers by phone on a daily basis.
•  Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to handle complex customer inquiries.
•  Able to balance administrative responsibilities with frequent customer interaction.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.
Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.
Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.
Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.
Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.
Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.
Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.
Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

Our client is a European organization operating within the retail and consumer goods sector.Based in Brussels, the business develops strategic partnerships and commercial initiatives across multiple European markets. It combines an entrepreneurial culture with an international mindset and offers significant exposure to senior decision-makers.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate international projects across several markets

We are looking for a production worker with a good knowledge of English. Are you handy and able to work with a pneumatic nail gun?

This company, located in Lokeren, is a growing family business specializing in the production, repair, and recycling of wooden pallets. To strengthen their team, we are looking for a motivated pallet repairer. Do you enjoy hands-on, repetitive work, and do you not shy away from physical labor? Then you might be the colleague the company is looking for. 

Your tasks:

• Assembling and repairing wooden pallets according to our quality standards.

• Working with a pneumatic nail gun.

• Sorting pallets by type and quality.

• Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe.

• Collaborating with your colleagues to meet daily production targets.

 

What we ask of you:

• You enjoy working with tools and like manual labor.

• You are physically fit and willing to work at a steady pace.

• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

• You can express yourself in English; having another native language is no problem (but English is a must).
